acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

initialize(address,(address,address,uint.details: The pool must be native eth / `coin_` and already initialized.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

processBurnOpenTab(uint256).details: D31: only `openTabCaller` (owner set, default none). Must run      while that caller holds the PoolManager unlock; otherwise the      PoolManager reverts `ManagerLocked`.      Shares `lastBurnBlock` with `processBurn`, so an outer caller that      moves the price cannot repeat the burn in the same block.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

rescue(address,address,uint256).details: The coin and native eth (the burn budget) can never be rescued.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

DEFAULT_MIN_PROCESS_THRESHOLD().notice: Default minimum eth balance a burn needs.

KEEPER_GAS().notice: Gas forwarded on the keeper reward push (no returndata copied).

MAX_BURN_PER_CALL_MIN().notice: D40: per burn eth cap bounds and default.

claimRefund().notice: Pulls this router's skim refunds from the fee escrow.

constantsHash().notice: `Constants.hash()` of the build this contract was compiled with.

floorFor(uint256).notice: Coin output floor a burn enforces for `ethIn` consumed at the         current spot. Same computation as the enforced check (LF-12);         the effective minimum is `max(minOut, floorFor(consumed))`.

initialize(address,(address,address,uint.notice: Owner, once. Binds the coin and its native eth pool.

maxBurnPerCall().notice: D40: most eth offered to the pool per burn, so a large balance         drains over blocks instead of failing its floor.

openTabCaller().notice: D31: the only caller of `processBurnOpenTab`; zero disables it.

poolBaselineSkimBps().notice: D50: pool baseline skim (SKIM_DENOMINATOR units) the floor nets out.

poolLpFee().notice: D50: pool lp fee (FEE_DENOMINATOR units) the floor nets out.

processBurn(uint256).notice: Swaps eth for the coin (impact capped) and burns it; pays the caller a keeper reward.

processBurnOpenTab(uint256).notice: As `processBurn` but settles the swap after taking (open tab).

rescue(address,address,uint256).notice: Sends tokens other than the coin.

setMaxBurnPerCall(uint256).notice: D40: sets the per burn eth cap within         [MAX_BURN_PER_CALL_MIN, MAX_BURN_PER_CALL_MAX].

setOpenTabCaller(address).notice: D31: sets the only `processBurnOpenTab` caller; zero disables it.

setSpotFloorBps(uint256).notice: D32: sets the output floor within Constants bounds.

spotFloorBps().notice: D32: current output floor in bps.

swapBudget().notice: What the next burn would offer the pool: balance plus pending         escrow refunds (claimed first by every burn) minus the reward         reserve, capped at `maxBurnPerCall`. Zero below `minProcessThreshold`.

syncPoolFees().notice: D50: anyone re reads the pool's known fees from the hook.         It can only set what the hook reports, so it is not gated.
